report.title: Recent checkout-web deploy removed Idempotency-Key header causing widespread duplicate charges (since ~2026-11-27T17:28Z)
report.summary: Since ~2026-11-27T17:28Z customers are receiving duplicate credit-card charges. The surge began minutes after a checkout-web deploy (d-4836 at 2026-11-27T17:27Z) that changed payment submission to a new PaymentsClient and removed the Idempotency-Key header.
report.customerImpact: Customers are being billed multiple times for single purchases (reconciliation shows ~5–8 duplicate charges/min and payment-service reports ~400 requests/min missing idempotency keys). Financial harm and support load; immediate mitigation required.

rootCause.description: The deploy replaced direct fetch POST to /checkout/complete (which set header 'Idempotency-Key': cart.checkoutAttemptId) with paymentsClient.post(...) but did not supply the Idempotency-Key. paymentsClient is configured to retry on timeouts, so timed-out requests retried without the idempotency header created distinct charges.

evidence.detail: duplicate_charges_per_min for payment-service rose from baseline 0 to 5.42 (latest) with change detected starting 2026-11-27T17:30Z; five-minute buckets show values 7.75 at 17:31Z, 5.45 at 17:36Z, up to 7.87 at 17:51Z.
charges_missing_idempotency_key_per_min on payment-service rose from 0 to ~400 (latest) with change detected starting 2026-11-27T17:28Z; buckets: 199 at 17:26Z, 399 at 17:31Z, ~400 thereafter.
Deploy d-4836 (checkout-web v2.8.0) succeeded at 2026-11-27T17:27Z with summary 'Migrate payment submission to new PaymentsClient'.

Deploy diff for d-4836 shows code change replacing fetch POST that included header 'Idempotency-Key': cart.checkoutAttemptId with paymentsClient.post(..., {timeoutMs:1500, retry:{attempts:2,onTimeout:true}}) — header removed.

checkout-web config shows paymentClient.retry.attempts=2 and onTimeout=true (paymentsClient will retry on timeouts). payment-service config shows idempotency.required=false and headerName 'Idempotency-Key'.

recommendedActions.rationale: This deploy removed the Idempotency-Key header; rolling back restores the previous behavior immediately and stops new duplicate charges fastest.

recommendedActions.target: checkout-web: hotfix to restore Idempotency-Key header when calling paymentsClient.post (or configure paymentsClient to forward existing headers and include idempotency key in request body)
recommendedActions.rationale: If rollback is not possible quickly, deploy a hotfix that sets header 'Idempotency-Key': cart.checkoutAttemptId on paymentsClient.post and avoids retrying on timeout for payment submissions.
Reconcile and refund affected charges found by the reconciliation job to remediate customer harm; prioritize high-value charges and inform support.

recommendedActions.target: checkout-web paymentClient retries / paymentsClient timeout behavior
recommendedActions.rationale: Temporarily disable client-side automatic retries for payment submission (or set onTimeout=false) to prevent duplicate attempts while provider is slow.
Continue monitoring these metrics and payment-provider error/latency; confirm duplicates stop after rollback/hotfix.

followUps: After mitigation, add automated integration test that ensures Idempotency-Key is preserved when switching HTTP clients.
Consider making idempotency.required=true in payment-service or validating presence of Idempotency-Key and rejecting/alerting earlier.
Run a support/communications plan: notify affected customers, prepare refund and complaint handling templates.
